newsitem.title: USA: FERC rejects British Columbia Hydro marketing plan.
newsitem.headline: FERC rejects British Columbia Hydro marketing plan.

text.p: The U.S. FERC Wednesday rejected a plan by British Columbia Hydro and Power Authority to sell power into the United States at market-based rates, saying it should revise its tariffs to gain approval.

The commission told the power authority that its planned tariff, which would allow U.S. utilities to use its transmission lines in return for letting it sell power at competitive rates into the United States, was not fair enough, according to an FERC spokeswoman.
To obtain a go-ahead, British Columbia Hydro would either have to prove it could not dominate the market or find ways to offset its dominant position, the commission said.
